props.name: data
props.comment: The fixed patch applied to every selected record. Default `{}`.

props.name: mutationMode
props.comment:
`"undoable"` updates optimistically with an Undo notification (no confirm
dialog): the rows patch now and the server call is deferred until the Undo
window closes. Default (`"pessimistic"`) is confirm-gated.

props.name: confirmContent
props.comment: Confirmation-dialog body copy (the V3-c `<Confirm>` upgrade will use this).
